authority: Every mapping below is implemented in TOSCANINI_UI/webapp/lib/present.ts and pinned by TOSCANINI_UI/webapp/tests/adversarial_present.test.mjs (14/14). The frontend renders through this layer and never re-derives or upgrades canonical state (EPISTEMIC_CONSTITUTION Art. X, XXV, XXVIII, LXI). Vocabulary ground truth: toscanini/run_state.py, toscanini/user_state.py, CIO maturity ladder.

COMPLETE.user: outcome tone decided by user_state/outcome below

INTERRUPTED.user: Run interrupted — infrastructure state, never a scientific result; Resume

RUN_BLOCKED_TRANSPORT.user: Current run blocked — infrastructure state, never a scientific result; stale positives suppressed; Resume

ERROR_*.user: Run stopped by an infrastructure failure — never a scientific verdict

NOT_REACHED.user: The evidence stage was not reached on this run — retrieval never began… not a finding about the problem.

PENDING.user: Evidence retrieval is in progress — I'm searching the indexed sources now.

RETRIEVED_ZERO.user: The searches completed and returned no matching records. …not evidence that the concept is novel or that no relevant work exists.

RETRIEVED_POSITIVE.user: Evidence card: N relevant sources · M shaped the design + domains; View evidence → workspace

FAILED.user: Evidence retrieval failed — infrastructure state, not evidence of absence…

GATHERED.user: the RAW canonical token on the wire (run_state.py::_evidence_state). The presentation layer derives the user sentence from records_found: > 0 -> RETRIEVED_POSITIVE ('I found N sources in the evidence base...'); == 0 -> RETRIEVED_ZERO ('the searches completed and returned no matching records' — a result about the searches, never about the problem).
GATHERED.production_evidence: production acceptance R453-C2: fresh run ts_94d163221011 on the live deploy at 8d019f3df7ef (Space revision 486bc0c7) observed this token on the wire; the UI rendered it honestly — the §47 document was missing it, not the interface

geometry_state.source: dossier design tab availability + conceptual/fallback_basis + hero_eligibility (R436 projection)

PENDING.user: The technology model will appear here as the design solidifies.

UNKNOWN.user: Engineering geometry is not established on this run. Nothing is rendered because nothing was established…

UNAVAILABLE.user: Engineering geometry exists on this run; the visual rendering is unavailable right now — an infrastructure state…

CONCEPTUAL.user: A conceptual architecture model is shown… not validated engineering geometry, never implies a physical result.

UNEARNED.user: The system could not produce a faithful visual representation — no substitute model is shown. (R436 hero suppression)
forbidden: generic fallback render on the primary surface

ENGINEERING.user: The technology model is the run's canonical engineering geometry — not an illustration.

render_availability.source: CIO/design renders record (visual_compiler render_record.json; R443 typed statuses)

RENDER_SKIPPED_LOW_MEMORY.user: Engineering geometry available; visual rendering unavailable at current deployment capacity.

RENDER_SKIPPED_*.user: …visual rendering unavailable in this deployment (renderer infrastructure unavailable).

gate FAIL/NOT_RUN/suppressed.user: …presentation renders are withheld — the visual quality gate did not certify them (fail-closed). (Art. LXXII)

gate PASS/COMPLETE_PASS.user: visual gate ✓ badge with verdict shown verbatim beside the model

NOT_RUN.user: The adversarial test has not been completed. Nothing is claimed either way — a candidate is never called 'survived' by default.

IN_PROGRESS.user: Now I'm trying to prove this wrong — the adversarial test is running.

SURVIVED.user: …survived the specified adversarial tests, including: <strongest challenge>.

CONTESTED.user: The adversarial instrument raised an objection it is not calibrated to decide… preserved and escalated — not a verdict, and not a pass either. (BS-011)

FAILED.user: The adversarial tests contradicted this candidate. Recorded cause: <kill_reason>.

UNRESOLVED.user: The adversarial result is unresolved — the recorded state carries no verdict.

COMPLETED_PACKAGE.user: Outcome: 'Completed — package ready' + Technology package artifact card + next action 'Download the technology package'

COMPLETED_CANDIDATE.user: Positive outcome with the candidate presented at its honest maturity; package card only when the record carries one

COMPLETED_EVOLVED.user: Positive outcome; generations rendered as competing hypotheses with per-generation attack states

COMPLETED_UNDER_DEVELOPMENT.user: Development outcome — the current architecture is presented with its honest maturity; diagnosed causes on record

COMPLETED_GENERATION_FAILED.user: Development outcome — honest generation failure, never a rejection of the problem

COMPLETED_FALSE_PREMISE.user: Outcome: 'Rejected' — the evidence contradicted the problem's premise; next action 'Reformulate the problem and run again'

COMPLETED_UNKNOWN.user: Outcome carried verbatim as unknown — never re-labeled

BLOCKED_TRANSPORT|FAILED_TRANSPORT|FAILE.user: Blocked outcome — infrastructure state, never a scientific result; Resume the investigation

RUN_BLOCKED.user: Same blocked handling; suppressStalePositives gates every positive surface

INCOMPLETE_INFERENCE_FAILURE.user: the run result's final_status token. The engine's own user_state_view renders it as user_state COMPLETED_UNKNOWN ('Completed — outcome unknown': the run reached a terminal state without a recorded verdict — the outcome could not be established from the run's own artifacts; decision: outcome not established; found_something=false, rejected=false) with outcome RUN_BLOCKED ('Run blocked — infrastructure, not a verdict'). The conversation renders the terminal-incomplete arc: 'Here is what the investigation found, and how far it got.' + 'I stopped partway — the infrastructure I need became unavailable.' + 'Nothing was concluded about your problem — this is an infrastructure state, not a verdict on the idea.' with the next action 'Resume the investigation'.
INCOMPLETE_INFERENCE_FAILURE.production_evidence: production acceptance R453-C2: fresh run ts_94d163221011 on the live deploy at 8d019f3df7ef (Space revision 486bc0c7) observed this token on the wire; the UI rendered it honestly — the §47 document was missing it, not the interface; the run carried evidence_state GATHERED + mechanism_state GENERATED + attack SKIPPED and concluded with NO candidate — the honest partial arc

engine_unreachable.user: The discovery service is not responding right now. Your runs are persisted… nothing about any discovery outcome is implied by this.

run_404.user: Run not found — private to its creator; if the rail is empty the run did not register (infrastructure state, never a scientific result).

in_run_progress.user: Live line from the run's own event record (active/paused summaries); infrastructure pauses render as their own state, never as active work.

NOT_IN_RECORD.user: 'Not in this record.' — answers only from the subject's persisted artifacts

REFUSED_OVERCLAIM.user: 'Refused by the reality guard.' (Art. XXXVIII boundary)

TRANSPORT_ERROR.user: 'The model transport is not answering.' — no fabricated answer, retry when transport responds

REFUSED.user: rendered verbatim with the recorded reason (e.g., run not finished)

epistemic_meta_labels.source: ScienceEvent.epistemic_class — the brief §10 vocabulary, derived never upgraded
epistemic_meta_labels.unmapped_class: rendered as-is (never promoted to a known label)

never_rendered_as.candidate (any maturity): 'New invention' — the word invented never precedes canonical classification (brief §26)
never_rendered_as.engineering representation: 'Engineered solution' unless engineering state is canonical
never_rendered_as.simulation/computation: 'Validated technology' — PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION requires the R370G door

GENERATED.user: A candidate mechanism emerged: <mechanism> — presented as a HYPOTHESIS at HYPOTHESIZED/INFERRED maturity, feeding the competing-hypotheses view; never an invention claim (Art. LXI: the candidate maturity is the ceiling).

FAILED.user: The mechanism synthesis could not complete — an honest development outcome; nothing was concluded about the problem.

PENDING.user: I'm forming candidate mechanisms from the evidence now — in progress, not a finding.

NOT_REACHED.user: The mechanism stage was not reached on this run — not a finding about the problem.
